messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: early-warning alert volume spiked for "onboarding_touch_lag" this morning. Seeing a lot of 'no-touch' accounts flagged as at-risk. Anyone else?
Sam - data-bot: alert: onboarding_touch_lag threshold breach (04:02 UTC) - 3.2x baseline. query_id: touch_lag_v2. run: https://redwood.internal/queries/1234
Elliot Chen: Noticed webhook delivery retries increased for the playbook webhook in eu-west around the same time. Could be event ingestion latency.
Maya Patel: @Elliot can you post delivery error logs? if it's retries, the playbook will mark touchpoints as missed and inflate risk.
Elliot Chen: Here are two log snippets:
```json
{"event":"webhook_fail","status":502,"count":27}
{"event":"webhook_retry","backoff_ms":1200}
```
Liz Ortega: Also seeing that the onboarding touchpoint rule uses `last_touch <= 14d` which is pretty fussy when ingestion lags. Suggest temporary widening to 21d while we investigate.
Rahul Singh: Agree. We should also backfill missing events for the window Apr 6 00:00 - Apr 6 04:00. I can run the backfill job but need ownership and a safe runbook.
Maya Patel: Plan: (1) Elliot open infra ticket + escalate delivery retries. (2) Rahul run backfill for 04:00 window. (3) Liz update playbook threshold to 21d for 48h and monitor. (4) I'll message AE ops to pause renewal outreach for accounts flagged in that window. @Liz pls confirm ETA.
Liz Ortega: ETA ~30m to patch playbook rule and add a staging test. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/CS/playbooks/onboard-touch-rules
Elliot Chen: Infra ticket INF-4521 created, attached traces and logs, cc eng-infra.
Sam - data-bot: backfill-job queued by Rahul Singh for window 2026-04-06T00:00:00Z - 2026-04-06T04:00:00Z. job_id: bf-789. status: queued.
Rahul Singh: Started backfill job bf-789. ETA ~25m, will post counts when done.
Maya Patel: Also let's add a quick guard in the alert: ignore onboarding_touch_lag spike if ingestion_error_rate > 1% to cut down false positives.
Liz Ortega: :thumbsup: will add the guard and run tests in staging before promoting.
Rahul Singh: Backfill completed for bf-789. inserted 1,128 touch events (sample ids: acct_1011, acct_2112, acct_3313).
Maya Patel: Great, alert volume back to normal. Will revert playbook threshold after 48h unless we see genuine churn signals. Closing loop, thanks all.
